title: Control endpoint (what the backend is told to dial)
description: `HERALD_OS_CONTROL_SOCKET`: `pipe://herald-os-<16 lowercase hex>` on Windows, or the absolute path of a unix socket ending in `herald-os/control.sock`. There is no TCP endpoint and there never will be one in v1. Producers emit this exact shape; the Python reader is deliberately more tolerant (`[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,200}`) and a Rust host must emit the strict form.
